facts.fact: The NINAuth consent-based identity verification platform, launched by President Tinubu on 30 October 2025, processes 1.3 million verification requests daily, says NIMC's head of Software and Biometrics.
NINAuth verifies identity for banks, for remote customer onboarding, and for telecom operators' SIM registration, all major operators being integrated, says NIMC's head of Software and Biometrics.
